historical_watchlist.title: CipherDM: Secure Three-Party Inference for Diffusion Model Sampling
historical_watchlist.topic: secure diffusion inference and MPC acceleration
historical_watchlist.why: CipherDM decomposes secure diffusion sampling latency and designs specialized MPC protocols for nonlinear activations. The official abstract reports 1.084×–2.328× runtime improvement and 1.212×–1.791× lower communication cost versus direct SPU implementation; retain as P1 because secure generative-model serving is a distinct and technically relevant systems direction.

historical_watchlist.title: GGRt: Towards Generalizable 3D Gaussians without Pose Priors in Real-Time
historical_watchlist.topic: real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting and scene inference
historical_watchlist.why: GGRt combines deferred backpropagation with a progressive Gaussian cache to reduce high-resolution processing and optimization overhead. The official abstract reports at least 5 FPS inference and at least 100 FPS real-time rendering on LLFF, KITTI, and Waymo; retain as P1 for real-time 3D scene representation, with full-paper resource baselines still to be checked.

historical_watchlist.title: Learning Equilibrium Transformation for Gamut Expansion and Color Restoration
historical_watchlist.why: LET uses an implicit recurrent transformation to reduce GPU training memory to O(1) complexity and reports a 40K-parameter model with improved PSNR. This is a concrete memory-efficient vision architecture; retain as P1 pending verification of the precise memory accounting and inference profile.

historical_watchlist.title: Dyn-Adapter: Towards Disentangled Representation for Efficient Visual Recognition
historical_watchlist.topic: dynamic adapters and FLOP-efficient visual transfer learning
historical_watchlist.why: Dyn-Adapter combines dynamic multi-level heads with bidirectional sparsity to reduce the full-forward-pass burden of parameter-efficient transfer learning. The official abstract reports 50% lower inference FLOPs while maintaining or improving recognition accuracy; retain as P1 for PETL inference optimization.

historical_watchlist.title: Time-Efficient and Identity-Consistent Virtual Try-On Using A Variant of Altered Diffusion Models
historical_watchlist.topic: fast diffusion inference for virtual try-on
historical_watchlist.why: FIP-VITON redesigns warping and try-on stages to preserve garment texture and identity while improving generation speed. The official abstract reports nearly 20× faster inference than the compared state of the art; retain as P1 because the speed claim is direct, while hardware, resolution, and sampling-setting comparability require full-paper verification.

historical_watchlist.title: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R
historical_watchlist.why: The paper addresses the quadratic complexity of dense matching and introduces reciprocal matching that accelerates matching by orders of magnitude while retaining geometric robustness. This is directly relevant to efficient 3D perception and localization; retain as P1, with exact latency and memory ratios to be checked in the full paper.

historical_watchlist.title: RecurrentBEV: A Long-term Temporal Fusion Framework for Multi-view 3D Detection
historical_watchlist.topic: low-latency temporal fusion for autonomous-driving perception
historical_watchlist.why: RecurrentBEV retains the latency and memory advantages of recurrent BEV fusion while improving long-term temporal information. The official abstract reports a real-time version at 25.6 FPS with 44.5% mAP and 54.9% NDS on nuScenes; retain as P1 Physical-AI perception/serving work.

historical_watchlist.title: Straightforward Layer-wise Pruning for More Efficient Visual Adaptation
historical_watchlist.why: SLS prunes redundant layers in parameter-efficient transfer-learned models and explicitly addresses the storage overhead of per-model pruning indices. The official abstract reports improved throughput and accuracy versus conventional pruning methods; retain as P1 pending full-paper FLOP, storage, and latency numbers.

historical_watchlist.title: Online Video Quality Enhancement with Spatial-Temporal Look-up Tables
historical_watchlist.topic: low-latency online video inference and LUT acceleration
historical_watchlist.why: STLVQE targets online video enhancement by reducing redundant computation and using spatial-temporal lookup tables to extract temporal information without future-frame dependence. The official abstract explicitly optimizes the performance-speed tradeoff for online deployment; retain as P1 pending exact FPS/latency and memory measurements.

historical_watchlist.title: Towards Robust Full Low-bit Quantization of Super Resolution Networks
historical_watchlist.why: The work directly studies full 4-bit quantization of super-resolution networks for terminal devices and reports multi-dB gains over a regular quantization baseline. This is a concrete low-bit robustness result relevant to quantized edge inference, although the workload is task-specific.

historical_watchlist.title: Solving the inverse problem of microscopy deconvolution with a residual Beylkin-Coifman-Rokhlin neural network
historical_watchlist.topic: Neural-network compression and efficient inverse-problem inference
historical_watchlist.why: The residual BCR network reports roughly 30–210x fewer parameters than comparison models and 3–300x shorter runtime on microscopy deconvolution tasks. Although application-specific, these are concrete model-size and inference-time efficiency results worth retaining.

historical_watchlist.title: Deep Diffusion Image Prior for Efficient OOD Adaptation in 3D Inverse Problems
historical_watchlist.why: D3IP is explicitly an efficient adaptation method for diffusion priors in 3D inverse problems and reports orders-of-magnitude acceleration over DDIP. This is directly relevant to diffusion/flow acceleration, with application-specific scope.

historical_watchlist.title: Spiking Wavelet Transformer
historical_watchlist.why: SWformer replaces global attention with an attention-free, multiplication-free spiking wavelet architecture and reports a 22.03% parameter reduction with improved ImageNet accuracy. The event-driven and energy-efficiency motivation makes it relevant to efficient architectures and edge accelerators.

historical_watchlist.title: Photon Inhibition for Energy-Efficient Single-Photon Imaging
historical_watchlist.why: Photon Inhibition adapts photon detection in real time to downstream inference goals and resource constraints, reporting over 90% fewer detections while maintaining task metrics on real and simulated data. This is a strong edge/sensor-compute and energy-efficiency result.

historical_watchlist.title: SWAG: Splatting in the Wild images with Appearance-conditioned Gaussians
historical_watchlist.why: SWAG extends 3D Gaussian Splatting to unstructured in-the-wild images and explicitly targets the high cost of volumetric rendering, reporting improved efficiency and state-of-the-art scene results. This is relevant to 3DGS and scene-computing acceleration.

historical_watchlist.title: Mini-Splatting: Representing Scenes with a Constrained Number of Gaussians
historical_watchlist.topic: 3D Gaussian Splatting resource and storage efficiency
historical_watchlist.why: Mini-Splatting explicitly constrains the number of Gaussians and introduces densification/simplification operations that improve rendering quality, resource consumption, and storage compression while preserving the original rasterization pipeline. This is directly relevant to efficient 3DGS and scene rendering.

historical_watchlist.title: Skeleton Recall Loss for Connectivity Conserving and Resource Efficient Segmentation of Thin Tubular Structures
historical_watchlist.topic: Compute-efficient segmentation and CPU/GPU workload placement
historical_watchlist.why: Skeleton Recall Loss replaces expensive GPU-based topology calculations with inexpensive CPU operations and reports more than 90% lower computational overhead on five datasets. Although it is a training-loss contribution for a specific vision task, the measured heterogeneous CPU/GPU efficiency result is substantial.

historical_watchlist.title: LATTE3D: Large-scale Amortized Text-To-Enhanced3D Synthesis
historical_watchlist.why: LATTE3D targets the per-prompt optimization bottleneck in text-to-3D generation and amortizes neural-field and textured-surface synthesis into a single forward pass. This is a relevant generative-workload acceleration strategy, although the extracted abstract omits a reliable numerical latency figure.

historical_watchlist.title: Adaptive Compressed Sensing with Diffusion-Based Posterior Sampling
historical_watchlist.topic: Diffusion posterior sampling and adaptive acquisition
historical_watchlist.why: AdaSense uses zero-shot posterior sampling with pretrained diffusion models for adaptive compressed sensing and reports practical acceleration of image acquisition, including MRI and CT settings. This is a relevant diffusion-based acceleration mechanism, although it is application-specific.

historical_watchlist.title: VideoAgent: Long-form Video Understanding with Large Language Model as Agent
historical_watchlist.topic: Frame-efficient long-form video understanding with an LLM agent
historical_watchlist.why: VideoAgent uses an LLM as an iterative reasoning agent with vision-language tools and reports 54.1%/71.3% zero-shot accuracy while consuming only 8.4/8.2 frames on average. This is a concrete token/frame-budget reduction for long-form multimodal reasoning and an important agent-system pattern, although hardware-serving gains are not quantified.

historical_watchlist.title: TurboEdit: Real-time text-based disentangled real image editing
historical_watchlist.topic: Few-step diffusion for real-time text-guided image editing
historical_watchlist.why: TurboEdit targets real-image inversion and disentangled editing using few-step diffusion models and iterative correction. The title and method are directly adjacent to low-step diffusion inference and real-time image generation, but the abstract does not provide a reliable end-to-end latency or compute reduction; retain as high-value watch rather than strong.

historical_watchlist.title: Hierarchical Separable Video Transformer for Snapshot Compressive Imaging
historical_watchlist.topic: Efficient separable video transformer for snapshot compressive imaging
historical_watchlist.why: HiSViT is explicitly designed around reconstruction efficiency, avoids temporal aggregation in early layers, and uses cross-scale separable attention and gated feed-forward blocks. This is a relevant efficient video-transformer architecture, although the abstract does not supply a quantitative speed, memory, or energy comparison; retain as high-value watch.

historical_watchlist.title: VSViG: Real-time Video-based Seizure Detection via Skeleton-based Spatiotemporal ViG
historical_watchlist.topic: Compact real-time video inference for continuous seizure detection
historical_watchlist.why: VSViG targets continuous video monitoring with a 1.4M-parameter, 0.4G-FLOP skeleton-based model and reports short detection latency (5.1 seconds after EEG onset, 13.1 seconds before clinical onset). This is a concrete compact real-time video-inference system, but its medical application is narrower than the core serving/accelerator scope; retain as high-value watch.

historical_watchlist.title: SRPose: Two-view Relative Pose Estimation with Sparse Keypoints
historical_watchlist.why: SRPose targets visual relocalization and object pose tracking, reports competitive accuracy and speed, and states low-compute deployment. The result is relevant to robotics perception, but the abstract lacks a quantitative latency/resource comparison.

historical_watchlist.title: Boost Your NeRF: A Model-Agnostic Mixture of Experts Framework for High Quality and Efficient Rendering
historical_watchlist.why: The method uses resolution-based MoE routing to induce sparsity and improve reconstruction without escalating computational complexity. It is directly relevant to efficient NeRF rendering, but reports competitive rather than quantified faster rendering.

historical_watchlist.title: Scene-Graph ViT: End-to-End Open-Vocabulary Visual Relationship Detection
historical_watchlist.why: Scene-Graph ViT removes separate relationship modules/decoders and uses implicit object-token relations with selective attention. The abstract reports real-time inference and state-of-the-art relationship detection, but no quantified compute or memory reduction; retain as a high-value efficient vision architecture watch.

historical_watchlist.title: DualBEV: Unifying Dual View Transformation with Probabilistic Correspondences
historical_watchlist.why: DualBEV replaces resource-intensive Transformer correspondence with a shared probabilistic view transformation and reports comparable efficiency to LSS with 55.2 mAP and 63.4 NDS on nuScenes. This is directly relevant to autonomous-driving perception, though the abstract gives no quantified speedup over LSS.

historical_watchlist.title: Learned Rate Control for Frame-Level Adaptive Neural Video Compression via Dynamic Neural Network
historical_watchlist.topic: Dynamic-route neural video compression and runtime rate control
historical_watchlist.why: The codec selects among variable-complexity neural routes at runtime through a rate-control agent, explicitly trading computational complexity against bitrate and rate-distortion quality. It reports 14.8% average BD-Rate reduction and 1.66% bitrate error, but no direct latency/energy comparison; retain as high-value dynamic-compute watch.

historical_watchlist.title: Enhancing Semantic Fidelity in Text-to-Image Synthesis: Attention Regulation in Diffusion Models
historical_watchlist.topic: Inference-time attention regulation for diffusion generation
historical_watchlist.why: The method performs on-the-fly attention-map optimization as a plug-in module without additional training and reports reduced computation overhead while improving semantic fidelity. This is directly relevant to diffusion inference, but the abstract lacks a quantitative overhead or latency measurement; retain as high-value watch.

historical_watchlist.title: Learning Where to Look: Self-supervised Viewpoint Selection for Active Localization using Geometrical Information
historical_watchlist.topic: Real-time active viewpoint selection for robotic localization
historical_watchlist.why: The method uses a simple real-time architecture for active localization and integrates viewpoint selection with a planning framework for real-world robotics. It is relevant to Physical-AI perception/runtime, but the abstract provides no quantitative latency or resource comparison.

historical_watchlist.title: Text-Conditioned Resampler For Long Form Video Understanding
historical_watchlist.topic: Text-conditioned resampling for long-video LLM understanding
historical_watchlist.why: TCR uses lightweight cross-attention to select task-relevant visual features from long videos and can process more than 100 frames with plain attention and no optimized kernels. This is a strong MLLM input-resampling pattern, but the abstract lacks token/latency comparisons.

historical_watchlist.title: Fast Diffusion-Based Counterfactuals for Shortcut Removal and Generation
historical_watchlist.why: The method uses self-optimized masking to localize counterfactual edits without extra inference steps and reports significant inference speedup at comparable image quality. It is directly relevant to diffusion inference, but the abstract provides no numerical speedup or compute measurement.

historical_watchlist.title: IFTR: An Instance-Level Fusion Transformer for Visual Collaborative Perception
historical_watchlist.why: IFTR shares instance-level visual features and explicitly optimizes communication efficiency to achieve a performance-bandwidth trade-off on DAIR-V2X, OPV2V, and V2XSet. This is relevant to distributed Physical-AI/cloud-edge perception, but the abstract lacks quantified bandwidth or end-to-end latency savings.

historical_watchlist.title: latentSplat: Autoencoding Variational Gaussians for Fast Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
historical_watchlist.topic: Fast generalizable 3D reconstruction with latent Gaussian splatting
historical_watchlist.why: latentSplat encodes uncertainty in variational 3D feature Gaussians and renders with efficient splatting plus a lightweight generative decoder. The abstract reports fast, scalable high-resolution reconstruction but lacks a quantified runtime or memory comparison; retain as high-value 3DGS watch.

historical_watchlist.title: Modality Translation for Object Detection Adaptation without forgetting prior knowledge
historical_watchlist.topic: Shared-server modality translation for cross-modal object detection
historical_watchlist.why: ModTr adapts IR inputs through a small translator while leaving the large RGB detector unchanged, avoiding full-model fine-tuning and enabling one shared server to serve multiple modalities. This is a strong heterogeneous-service pattern, but the abstract does not quantify runtime, memory, or throughput savings.

historical_watchlist.title: FroSSL: Frobenius Norm Minimization for Efficient Multiview Self-Supervised Learning
historical_watchlist.why: FroSSL replaces covariance eigendecomposition with Frobenius-norm objectives and reports faster convergence to competitive accuracy. This is directly relevant to training efficiency, but the abstract provides no wall-clock or compute reduction figure.

historical_watchlist.title: Snuffy: Efficient Whole Slide Image Classifier
historical_watchlist.why: Snuffy uses pathology-specific sparse transformers to reduce the computational burden of whole-slide multiple-instance learning and enables competitive continual few-shot pretraining with limited pretraining. The abstract reports accuracy and a size/time trade-off but no numerical latency or model-size result; retain as a high-value watch.

historical_watchlist.title: DGE: Direct Gaussian 3D Editing by Consistent Multi-view Editing
historical_watchlist.topic: direct and efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting editing
historical_watchlist.why: DGE makes 2D guidance multi-view consistent and directly optimizes the 3D Gaussian representation, avoiding incremental edits and repeated updates of costly 3D representations. This is a concrete algorithmic route to lower 3DGS editing cost and is especially relevant to 3D scene acceleration; retain as P1 pending full-paper latency and quality verification.

historical_watchlist.title: MLPHand: Real Time Multi-View 3D Hand Reconstruction via MLP Modeling
historical_watchlist.why: MLPHand combines a lightweight MLP-based Skeleton2Mesh module with multi-view geometry fusion and reports a 90% reduction in computational complexity at comparable reconstruction accuracy. The measured complexity reduction is a direct efficiency result, though the task is application-specific; retain as P1 pending full-paper verification.

historical_watchlist.topic: Visual geometry transformer token and KV redundancy reduction
historical_watchlist.why: A training-free layer-aware compression method for a multi-view geometry transformer, combining saliency-guided token merging with protected K/V downsampling for pose-critical paths. It reports 6.7x speedup at matched reconstruction quality, making it a strong visual/physical-AI acceleration watch.

historical_watchlist.title: Real-Time Visual Obstruction Detection in Surgical Augmented Reality
historical_watchlist.topic: Cascaded VLM inference, visual-token pruning and early exit
historical_watchlist.why: A latency-aware perception pipeline combines a small-to-large VLM cascade, segmentation-guided early exit and visual-token pruning. It reports 62.9% lower end-to-end latency than a cloud large-model baseline; retain as a promising embodied/surgical perception optimization while noting the pseudo-AR benchmark and preliminary clinical scope.

historical_watchlist.title: Otter Weather: Skillful and Computationally Efficient Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
historical_watchlist.why: 摘要给出明确 skill-compute Pareto 改进：确定性天气模型训练少于 3.5 A100-days，且相对高计算量前沿架构声称约 100 倍 compute reduction；属于领域专用模型，但训练计算效率证据较强。

historical_watchlist.title: From Senses to Decisions: The Information Flow of Auditory and Visual Perception in Multimodal LLMs
historical_watchlist.why: 直接研究 AV-LLM 的信息流，并展示信息传递完成后可丢弃音视频 token、对预测影响很小甚至略有改善；在 Qwen2.5-Omni 与 Video-SALMONN2 Plus 的 3B/7B 模型上验证，属于 MLLM token pruning/高效推理。

historical_watchlist.title: POTATR: A Lightweight Image-to-Graph Model for Page-Level Table Extraction
historical_watchlist.why: 提出 29M 参数的轻量 image-to-graph 模型，摘要报告相对所测模型（包括 frontier MLLMs）超过 130 倍速度、约 300 倍成本优势；是有明确量化收益的专用高效视觉模型。

historical_watchlist.title: Large-scale empirical tuning and comparison of default optimizers for variational inference
historical_watchlist.why: 该工作以1092个变分推断问题、56种优化器和超过55万次运行系统比较调参成本与优化表现，并指出少量优化器组合即可接近观测到的最佳结果。它提供了训练/推断优化器选择和计算预算管理方面的大规模实证证据，具有较高方法学参考价值；但尚非新硬件或serving方案，先列高价值观察并尝试获取全文。

historical_watchlist.title: PointRAFT: 3D deep learning for high-throughput prediction of potato tuber weight from partial point clouds
historical_watchlist.why: 该工作在真实采收设备采集的部分点云上进行3D回归，利用高度嵌入改善估计，并报告每个点云6.3 ms的预处理与推理时间及公开代码/权重。它提供了可核查的真实场景高吞吐3D感知证据，与边缘视觉和机器人感知相关，值得保留并尝试获取全文；但尚无通用加速器或跨任务效率证据，暂不强晋级。

historical_watchlist.title: Walma: Learning to See Memory Corruption in WebAssembly
historical_watchlist.why: WALMA将1.9M参数ResNet嵌入WebAssembly运行时执行内存完整性检查，并在53个二进制上报告1.07x–1.69x边界验证开销；它把小型CNN、运行时集成与明确的性能开销联系起来，直接涉及edge/runtime ML部署权衡，值得保留为P1并立即尝试官方PDF。

historical_watchlist.title: SARES-DEIM: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Meets DETR for Clutter-Aware SAR Ship Detection
historical_watchlist.why: SARES-DEIM以稀疏MoE路由控制SAR目标检测的激活计算，并报告A40上136.5 FPS、batch-1延迟37.6 ms及72.6 GFLOPs，提供了可核验的稀疏专家视觉推理成本与性能数据；虽然是专用检测模型而非通用serving方案，仍值得高价值观察并尝试获取全文。

historical_watchlist.title: Efficient and Adaptable Detection of Malicious LLM Prompts via Bootstrap Aggregation
historical_watchlist.why: BAGEL以多个小型专用分类器和可选轻量路由器构建提示安全检测，在430M等效规模下达到0.757 F1，并报告低于大型白盒Guardrail的成本与多轮效果；这是可部署的低成本LLM安全推理系统，值得高价值观察并尝试获取全文。

historical_watchlist.title: MEgoVista: Multi-view Ego-aware Motion Estimation for Metric 4D Hands and Head in the Wild
historical_watchlist.why: MEgoVista把头戴式视频转换为具备公制尺度的双手/头部运动监督，面向具身基础模型；其MEgoDeploy生产GPU栈在保持重建保真度下报告14.05x端到端吞吐提升，直接覆盖Physical-AI数据流水线和GPU加速，属于高价值P1。

historical_watchlist.title: Teleoperated Driving: a New Challenge for 3D Object Detection in Compressed Point Clouds
historical_watchlist.why: 该工作针对远程驾驶LiDAR点云，系统比较G-PCC/Draco压缩、压缩解压时间、检测精度以及V2X链路数据率和时延，直接覆盖Physical-AI感知数据压缩与云边传输取舍，具有明确可测量的效率指标，列为高价值P1。

historical_watchlist.title: TAMF-VTON: Token-Wise Sparse Adaptation for Mask-Free Virtual Try-On
historical_watchlist.why: TAMF-VTON在扩散式虚拟试衣中使用token-wise稀疏MoE适配，并报告INT4下RTX 4090生成1K图像低于15秒、2K图像低于30秒，直接覆盖低比特、稀疏专家与图像生成推理，值得作为P1高价值观察。

historical_watchlist.title: Binary Agreement for Efficient Unsupervised Confidence Calibration of Reasoning LLMs
historical_watchlist.why: BASC利用单次独立探测与跨查询汇总完成推理LLM置信度校准，将校准查询控制到每题最多两次响应、部署时只需一次响应，直接降低推理采样预算，且覆盖多任务和多模型，属于高价值高效推理P1。

historical_watchlist.title: Parameter-Efficient Multi-Task Fine-Tuning in Code-Related Tasks
historical_watchlist.why: 直接研究 1.5B/3B/7B 代码模型的多任务 QLoRA 微调，以参数高效微调降低全量微调的资源需求，并比较单任务 QLoRA 与多任务全量微调；与 LLM 参数高效适配高度相关，保留为 P1 Watchlist，暂不晋升 Strong，因为摘要未给出完整训练成本/显存/时延账本。

historical_watchlist.title: Teaching the Way, Not the Answer: Privileged Tutoring Distillation for Multimodal Policy Optimization
historical_watchlist.why: PTD-PO directly targets inefficient multimodal RLVR exploration and introduces Top-K Jensen-Shannon alignment to reduce memory overhead while training 2B-8B LVLMs; retain as a high-value multimodal reasoning and post-training efficiency method, with quantitative resource savings still to be verified.

historical_watchlist.title: PRISM: Prompt-Refined In-Context System Modelling for Financial Retrieval
historical_watchlist.why: PRISM is a training-free LLM retrieval pipeline with explicit per-query latency, token, and dollar accounting; it reports about 35% lower per-query cost and a quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier, making it a high-value serving and retrieval-cost result.

historical_watchlist.title: Multiparameter Uncertainty Mapping in Quantitative Molecular MRI using a Physics-Structured Variational Autoencoder (PS-VAE)
historical_watchlist.why: The physics-structured VAE reports orders-of-magnitude acceleration for whole-brain quantitative MRI inference and supports real-time adaptive acquisition; retain as a high-value specialized scientific-ML inference-acceleration result.

historical_watchlist.title: SAEs Can Improve Unlearning: Dynamic Sparse Autoencoder Guardrails for Precision Unlearning in LLMs
historical_watchlist.why: Dynamic SAE Guardrails directly targets the high computational cost and instability of gradient-based LLM unlearning and claims improved computational efficiency, sequential unlearning, and data efficiency; retain as a high-value LLM unlearning optimization, with quantitative resource savings to verify.

historical_watchlist.title: A Counterfactual Graph Approach to Oppositional Narrative Analysis
historical_watchlist.why: The graph-transformer method achieves comparable predictive quality with roughly one-third the parameters of the next-best system and prunes 75.2% of graph structure without changing predictions; retain as a high-value sparsity and model-footprint reduction result.

historical_watchlist.title: SEMIR: Topology-Preserving Graph Minors for Thin-Structure Segmentation
historical_watchlist.why: SEMIR replaces a pixel lattice with a topology-preserving graph minor that contracts millions of pixels into tens or hundreds of supernodes, while supporting full-resolution inference up to 21 MP and preserving thin-structure connectivity. This is a concrete representation-compression path for high-resolution visual inference with accuracy and topology safeguards. Retain as a high-value watch item; the abstract does not yet quantify end-to-end latency, memory, or energy savings, so do not promote to strong.

historical_watchlist.title: Amortized Factor Inference Networks for Posterior Inference
historical_watchlist.why: AFIN amortizes posterior inference across varying priors, likelihoods, latent dimensions, and observation counts, and the abstract explicitly reports substantially lower test-time cost than NUTS and per-task variational inference. The cross-model factorized inference interface is technically relevant to efficient inference, although the workload is Bayesian inference rather than mainstream serving and the abstract does not provide matched latency or energy figures. Retain for full-text review.

historical_watchlist.title: Decoupled Data Consistency with Diffusion Purification for Image Restoration
historical_watchlist.why: The diffusion image-restoration method directly targets the inference overhead of repeated likelihood-gradient data-consistency steps, decouples those steps from the reverse diffusion process, and combines the design with consistency models to reduce sampling steps. This is directly relevant to diffusion/flow acceleration and practical image-generation inference. Retain as high-value watch; the abstract does not provide quantitative speedup, memory, or energy results, so do not promote to strong.

historical_watchlist.title: Evolutionary Deep Nets for Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring
historical_watchlist.why: The non-intrusive load-monitoring study combines sparse evolutionary training and warm-start compression for compact appliance classifiers intended for memory- and compute-constrained local monitoring. It reports 17.36% fewer stored weights and 23.93% fewer active first-layer connections while approximately preserving binary accuracy and improving macro F1. Retain as a high-value edge-model compression result, but the three-seed study and unverified source-window independence require full-text scrutiny before stronger promotion.

historical_watchlist.title: BRIDGE: Background Routing and Isolated Discrete Gating for Coarse-Mask Local Editing
historical_watchlist.why: BRIDGE targets diffusion-transformer image editing and offers mask-cropped inference that removes out-of-mask subject tokens without training a sparse model that overfits the mask silhouette. This is a direct inference-time token-reduction mechanism for image generation while preserving background support and subject geometry. Retain as high-value watch; the abstract does not quantify latency or memory savings.

historical_watchlist.title: Eddeep: a deep-learning framework for fast eddy-current distortion correction in diffusion MRI
historical_watchlist.why: Eddeep replaces iterative prediction-correction for diffusion-MRI eddy-current correction with a two-stage learned pipeline that performs correction in a single forward pass. The abstract reports correction quality comparable to FSL Eddy while substantially reducing inference time, with in- and out-of-domain evaluation and an official code release. Retain as a high-value fast-inference medical-imaging result; verify quantitative speedup and hardware details in the full paper.

historical_watchlist.title: Learning a Sampling-Free Variational DNN Plugin from Tiny Training Sets to Refine OOD Segmentation With Uncertainty Estimation
historical_watchlist.why: VarDeepPCA is a lightweight variational DNN plugin for OOD medical segmentation that explicitly enables computationally efficient, sampling-free learning and inference from small in-distribution datasets. It is evaluated across four clinical applications and 14 public datasets. Retain as a high-value sampling-free inference and lightweight segmentation result; the abstract does not provide matched latency, memory, or energy numbers, so keep it on watch pending full-text review.

historical_watchlist.title: ReactiveBFM: Reactive Closed-Loop Motion Planning Towards Universal Humanoid Whole-Body Control
historical_watchlist.why: ReactiveBFM面向Unitree G1人形机器人闭环控制，针对自回归规划与高频跟踪的延迟失配提出异步重规划和轨迹分块，并在真实机器人上验证；直接命中Physical AI的action/planning runtime与低延迟执行，值得优先全文阅读，但摘要尚不足以强晋级。

historical_watchlist.title: GREAT: A Graph Edge Attention Network for the Electric Vehicle Routing Problem with Asymmetric Costs
historical_watchlist.why: GREAT以edge-space GNN和端到端强化学习联合优化电动车路线与充电决策；摘要报告能耗最高降低8.78%、运行时间缩短60倍，具有直接的算法效率与能耗证据，列为高价值观察而非核心系统加速论文。

historical_watchlist.title: ATLAS: A Foundation Neural Sampler for Amorphous Materials
historical_watchlist.why: ATLAS结合扩散过程与等变GNN进行非晶材料采样；摘要报告低温自由能误差低于0.2%、能量评估次数减少500倍以上，并通过composition-amortized预训练将逆向设计成本降低数百倍，是明确的科学ML采样计算效率成果。

historical_watchlist.title: The Quantization Benefits of Residual-Free Transformers
historical_watchlist.why: 论文从架构层解释残差连接造成激活非高斯性并损害低比特量化，提出残差自由Transformer与训练稳定化方案；虽然缺少端侧推理或硬件实测，但对量化友好模型设计具有直接启发，列为高价值观察。

historical_watchlist.title: Explicit 3D Gaussian Models for Fast, Mesh-Free Compression of Structured and Unstructured Volumes
historical_watchlist.why: 论文以显式3D Gaussian表示压缩结构化/非结构化体数据，配套优化CUDA采样流水线和误差驱动致密化，报告训练速度与重建质量收益；虽不是典型3DGS新视角渲染，但对3D表示压缩与GPU加速有直接参考价值。

historical_watchlist.title: LightSplit: Practical Privacy-Preserving Split Learning via Orthogonal Projections (Full Version)
historical_watchlist.topic: Distributed training / split learning / edge-cloud通信压缩
historical_watchlist.why: LightSplit直接面向split learning客户端—服务器协同训练，通过固定正交投影压缩cut-layer激活并降低通信开销；在多个基准上最高32x压缩仍保留至少94%若干任务准确率、8x下ImageNet top-1保留92%，且无需新增可训练客户端模块，契合分布式训练与edge/cloud异构系统。作为高价值P1保留并立即尝试官方PDF。

historical_watchlist.title: From Faulty Memories to Corrected Actions: Dependency-Guided Rollback Repair for Memory-Augmented Agents
historical_watchlist.topic: Efficient agent systems / persistent memory / selective replay
historical_watchlist.why: 该工作为memory-augmented LLM agents构建带运行时provenance的memory-to-action依赖图，只回滚受污染状态并选择性重放受影响计算；150例受控基准中恢复率85.3%对77.3%，LLM调用减少41.8%，同时明确暴露复发率高于全量式修复的trade-off。直接契合efficient agent runtime与persistent memory，保留P1并立即尝试官方PDF。

historical_watchlist.title: LLM-Driven, Datasheet-Aware Automated Hardware Compatibility Verification for Early-Stage, Pre-Schematic Embedded System Design
historical_watchlist.topic: Efficient agents / hardware design automation / context reduction
historical_watchlist.why: LLM硬件兼容性验证框架通过设计图、任务相关属性检索与确定性脚本分解工作流，避免直接上传整份datasheet；在7个设计、34份datasheet上达到97.5%准确率，并将输入context缩小8.6倍。直接契合高效agent与硬件设计自动化，保留P1并立即尝试官方PDF。

historical_watchlist.title: Knowledge Offloading: Decomposing LLMs into Sparse Backbones and Memory Modules
historical_watchlist.why: Official first-party arXiv abstract review: the framework moves domain-specific capacity from a dense LLM backbone into sparse adapters and learned KV memories while preserving much of model quality, a useful compression direction. This is directly relevant to a covered efficiency direction, but the abstract leaves an important measurement, generality, or hardware-validation question open; retain for focused follow-up rather than treating it as confirmed strong.

historical_watchlist.title: Depth-Recurrent Attention Mixture (Dreamer): Giving Latent Reasoning the Attention it Deserves
historical_watchlist.why: Official first-party arXiv abstract review: depth-recurrent attention mixtures claim fewer training tokens for latent reasoning, a promising compute-efficiency result whose inference and hardware implications need follow-up. This is directly relevant to a covered efficiency direction, but the abstract leaves an important measurement, generality, or hardware-validation question open; retain for focused follow-up rather than treating it as confirmed strong.

historical_watchlist.title: Zero-Shot Quantization via Weight-Space Arithmetic
historical_watchlist.why: Official first-party arXiv abstract review: weight-space arithmetic enables zero-shot low-bit quantization and reports accuracy behavior, making it a useful quantization candidate pending hardware throughput evidence. This is directly relevant to a covered efficiency direction, but the abstract leaves an important measurement, generality, or hardware-validation question open; retain for focused follow-up rather than treating it as confirmed strong.

historical_watchlist.title: ASAP: Attention Sink Anchored Pruning
historical_watchlist.why: Official first-party arXiv abstract review: attention-sink-anchored pruning targets redundant visual tokens and is relevant to efficient multimodal inference, pending clearer end-to-end speed and quality evidence. This is directly relevant to a covered efficiency direction, but the abstract leaves an important measurement, generality, or hardware-validation question open; retain for focused follow-up rather than treating it as confirmed strong.

historical_watchlist.title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
historical_watchlist.why: Official first-party arXiv abstract review: visual-redundancy-aware position selection targets parallel decoding steps in diffusion MLLMs, a relevant multimodal inference method needing full speed-quality validation. This is directly relevant to a covered efficiency direction, but the abstract leaves an important measurement, generality, or hardware-validation question open; retain for focused follow-up rather than treating it as confirmed strong.

historical_watchlist.title: Free-Editor: Zero-shot Text-driven 3D Scene Editing
historical_watchlist.topic: training-free 3D scene editing with runtime and memory reduction
historical_watchlist.why: The official ECVA abstract explicitly removes model retraining and multi-view editing, reports reduced editing time and memory requirements, and claims approximately 20x runtime improvement over prior methods. This is a directly measured efficiency contribution in a 3D generative-scene editing pipeline; retain as P1 for full-text verification of the baseline, measurement setup, and resource accounting.

historical_watchlist.title: AgentServe: Algorithm-System Co-Design for Efficient Agentic AI Serving on a Consumer-Grade GPU
historical_watchlist.why: Official OAI abstract describes a single-GPU multi-agent serving system that separates cold prefill, resume prefill and latency-critical decode, with dynamic budgeting and CUDA Green Context scheduling; reported TTFT/TPOT gains justify high-value follow-up, but full-paper and baseline verification are still required.

historical_watchlist.title: SeKV: Resolution-Adaptive KV Cache with Hierarchical Semantic Memory for Long-Context LLM Inference
historical_watchlist.why: Official abstract describes decode-time resolution restoration for a non-evicting hierarchical KV representation, with GPU/CPU tiering and per-head routing; the memory and decode-transfer claims are relevant, but lossiness and workload limits need verification.

historical_watchlist.title: Murmur: Efficient Long-Context ASR Inference with Hierarchical Chunking
historical_watchlist.why: Official abstract describes hierarchical long-context ASR chunking with structure-aware speculative decoding, an explicit inference-system contribution for a multimodal workload; retain pending latency, accuracy and deployment-cost validation.

historical_watchlist.title: LAMP: Look-Ahead Mixed-Precision Inference of Large Language Models
historical_watchlist.why: The official abstract presents look-ahead mixed-precision computation for transformer inference and reports large numerical-accuracy improvements at low recomputation rates; retain as a relevant inference-precision candidate, pending full-paper verification of latency, energy and workload coverage.

historical_watchlist.title: Corrective Diffusion Language Models
historical_watchlist.why: Corrective Diffusion Language Models explicitly trains masked diffusion LMs to identify and revise erroneous visible tokens; the official abstract reports improved correction and parallel-decoding effectiveness under matched compute, with transfer across model scales and code/math tasks. It is highly relevant to diffusion-generation decoding and could enable more effective parallel refinement, but the abstract does not yet establish a direct reduction in denoising steps, latency, or energy; retain as a high-value watchlist rather than a strong efficiency promotion.

historical_watchlist.title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
historical_watchlist.why: The official arXiv title explicitly targets efficient test-time adaptation of vision-language models; it is a relevant multimodal inference watch, not a KV-cache paper.

historical_watchlist.title: LoRANN: Low-Rank Matrix Factorization for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
historical_watchlist.why: The official arXiv abstract reports lower query latency and memory use than product quantization and competitive GPU ANN search; retain as a high-value retrieval-infrastructure watch rather than misclassifying it as neural quantization.

historical_watchlist.title: LSH-MoE: Communication-efficient MoE Training via Locality-Sensitive Hashing
historical_watchlist.why: Official arXiv title/abstract evidences an efficiency mechanism or efficient reasoning contribution in MoE systems and accelerators; retain for deeper reading, but P0 evidence is insufficient.

historical_watchlist.title: VQ4ALL: Efficient Neural Network Representation via a Universal Codebook
historical_watchlist.why: Official arXiv title/abstract evidences an efficiency mechanism or efficient reasoning contribution in quantization; retain for deeper reading, but P0 evidence is insufficient.

historical_watchlist.title: Demystifying Cost-Efficiency in LLM Serving over Heterogeneous GPUs
historical_watchlist.why: Official arXiv title/abstract evidences an efficiency mechanism or efficient reasoning contribution in LLM serving; retain for deeper reading, but P0 evidence is insufficient.

historical_watchlist.title: GaLore 2: Large-Scale LLM Pre-Training by Gradient Low-Rank Projection
historical_watchlist.why: The official arXiv abstract describes large-scale LLM pretraining with gradient low-rank projection; retain as a training-memory efficiency paper, but do not mislabel it as weight quantization.

historical_watchlist.title: ReStNet: A Reusable & Stitchable Network for Dynamic Adaptation on IoT Devices
historical_watchlist.why: The official arXiv abstract describes dynamically stitching pretrained networks to adapt to heterogeneous device memory and compute budgets; relevant to edge deployment, but the evidence is less direct than a dedicated serving accelerator.

historical_watchlist.title: EvoEngineer: Mastering Automated CUDA Kernel Code Evolution with Large Language Models
historical_watchlist.why: Official arXiv title/abstract evidences an efficiency mechanism or efficient reasoning contribution in GPU kernels, DSLs, compilers; retain for deeper reading, but P0 evidence is insufficient.

historical_watchlist.title: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
historical_watchlist.why: The official arXiv abstract describes a deployable VLA/action-reasoning system and an adaptive-depth variant that recomputes reasoning only for changed scene regions; retain as a high-value Physical-AI watch, not a P0 accelerator paper.

historical_watchlist.title: EMO: Frustratingly Easy Progressive Training of Extendable MoE
historical_watchlist.why: Official arXiv title/abstract evidences an efficiency mechanism or efficient reasoning contribution in MoE systems and accelerators; retain for deeper reading, but P0 evidence is insufficient.

historical_watchlist.title: Harnessing Routing Foresight for Micro-step-level MoE load balancing in RL Post-training
historical_watchlist.why: Official arXiv title/abstract evidences an efficiency mechanism or efficient reasoning contribution in MoE systems and accelerators; retain for deeper reading, but P0 evidence is insufficient.

historical_watchlist.title: The Sparsity Ceiling: Where Spiking Networks Can and Cannot Trade Activity for Energy
historical_watchlist.why: The official arXiv title and abstract focus on the energy implications and limits of activity sparsity in spiking networks; this is an energy-efficiency watch, not a KV-cache paper.

historical_watchlist.title: vLLM-Omni: Fully Disaggregated Serving for Any-to-Any Multimodal Models
historical_watchlist.why: Official arXiv title/abstract evidences an efficiency mechanism or efficient reasoning contribution in LLM serving; retain for deeper reading, but P0 evidence is insufficient.

historical_watchlist.title: Efficient Long-Range Transformers: You Need to Attend More, but Not Necessarily at Every Layer
historical_watchlist.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2023
historical_watchlist.why: A 1.3B decoder-only model remains competitive with full-attention Transformers while reducing compute by up to 75%; this is a direct, high-value efficient-attention/long-context result.

historical_watchlist.title: MUX-PLMs: Data Multiplexing for High-throughput Language Models
historical_watchlist.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2023
historical_watchlist.topic: LLM serving throughput and data multiplexing
historical_watchlist.why: The paper reports 2x/5x inference speedup with a 1-4% task-quality drop; the method is older and PLM-oriented, but its serving-throughput mechanism merits a high-value watch.

historical_watchlist.title: TESTA: Temporal-Spatial Token Aggregation for Long-form Video-Language Understanding
historical_watchlist.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2023
historical_watchlist.why: The paper reports 75% fewer visual tokens and 1.7x video-encoding efficiency, making it a high-value multimodal/long-video efficiency reference.

historical_watchlist.title: Towards High-Consistency Embodied World Model with Multi-View Trajectory Videos
historical_watchlist.why: High-consistency embodied world model with multi-view trajectory videos; retain as a high-value Physical-AI architecture watchlist.. First-party arXiv metadata/abstract verified. Retain as high-value watchlist for further paper-level efficiency and official-project validation; do not claim an explicit runtime gain not present in the abstract.

historical_watchlist.title: HyperVL: An Efficient and Dynamic Multimodal Large Language Model for Edge Devices
historical_watchlist.topic: Efficient multimodal models for edge devices

historical_p2.why: 该工作使用MERA启发的张量网络自编码器，并报告相对稠密自编码器约三分之一的可训练参数，涉及模型结构与参数效率。其应用局限于对撞机喷注异常检测，摘要没有推理延迟、能耗或部署测量，因而仅作为参数高效模型的低优先级交叉证据。

historical_p2.title: OpenFinGym: A Verifiable Multi-Task Gym Environment for Evaluating Quant Agents
historical_p2.why: 该工作提供覆盖预测、市场生成、交易和欺诈检测的量化金融agent评测环境，并强调容器化执行与验证接口。它可作为多阶段agent运行与评测基础设施的邻域参考，但摘要没有模型推理优化、吞吐/成本基线或AI加速机制，因此不进入高价值层。

historical_p2.title: Knowledge Based Wind Turbine Gearbox Fault Detection Using Sparse Filtering and Graph Neural Networks
historical_p2.why: 该工作结合稀疏特征学习与图神经网络进行风机齿轮箱状态检测，涉及多传感器结构化ML和工业监测。摘要没有计算成本、推理时延、模型压缩或硬件效率数据，故只保留为低优先级工业边缘ML邻域。

historical_p2.title: Scalable and adaptive prediction bands with kernel sum-of-squares
historical_p2.why: 该工作将条件覆盖预测带转化为核学习与sum-of-squares优化问题，并用加速梯度方法替代通用半定规划求解器，具有明确的算法计算效率动机。其范围限于conformal prediction且未涉及模型系统或硬件加速，故作为低优先级算法效率证据保留。

historical_p2.title: OpInf-LLM: Parametric PDE Solving with LLMs via Operator Inference
historical_p2.why: 该工作将算子推断与LLM任务接口结合，以少量解数据求解参数化PDE，并明确强调较低计算需求。它属于科学ML中的降阶建模和计算效率邻域，但摘要缺少与通用大模型系统或硬件加速的直接比较，故低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: RCOMPSs: A Scalable Runtime System for R Code Execution on Manycore Systems
historical_p2.why: 该工作提出面向R程序的任务化manycore运行时，并在KNN、K-means和线性回归上报告多节点扩展性及多数设置下超过70%的并行效率。它对传统ML分析负载的运行时调度有参考价值，但不是深度学习/LLM专用系统，故仅低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: Sparse Reward Subsystem in Large Language Models
historical_p2.why: 论文发现LLM隐藏状态中的价值神经元和多巴胺神经元构成稀疏奖励子系统，并将其用于置信度估计与推理期搜索的过程奖励；与稀疏内部结构和高效推理搜索直接邻接，但摘要未证明FLOPs、时延或显存下降，故仅P2而不升级为高价值Watch。

historical_p2.title: Evasive Intelligence: Lessons from Malware Analysis for Evaluating AI Agents
historical_p2.why: 该文提出借鉴恶意软件分析的AI Agent评测原则，包括多种harness、shadow execution、环境探测和部署后复测；与Agent运行环境和评测基础设施有关，但没有运行时成本或吞吐优化，故仅低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: Optimal Value Inference for Reinforcement Learning
historical_p2.why: 论文研究离线RL最优价值推断，并在真实决策任务和Agent工具使用中验证估计程序；与RL/Agent决策算法相关，但贡献是统计推断有效性而非训练或推理效率，低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: An Efficient Minimax-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial $m$-Set Bandits
historical_p2.why: 该工作针对组合对抗bandit提出不枚举指数规模动作集的多项式时间算法，并给出匹配高概率minimax下界；属于计算高效的在线学习算法，但与深度模型、serving和硬件系统距离较远，故仅P2保留。

historical_p2.title: AgentSnare: Learning to Delay, Divert, and Defuse Autonomous Web Penetration Agents
historical_p2.why: AgentSnare为在线Web安全Agent构建轨迹自适应诱饵环境，并因大模型构造器昂贵且缓慢而训练小LLM；与小模型Agent部署、虚拟内核和长时交互运行时直接相邻，但摘要没有小模型相对大模型的延迟/成本量化，故P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Efficient Cross-Scale Invertible Hiding Network with Spatial-Frequency Collaboration and Non-Invertible Mechanism
historical_p2.why: CrosInv提出跨尺度、空频协同的可逆神经网络图像隐藏架构，题目声称efficient但摘要未提供参数量、FLOPs、时延或能耗对比；仅作为图像模型架构效率邻域的低优先级记录。

historical_p2.title: How Does Machine Learning Manage Complexity?
historical_p2.why: 该理论工作将训练解释为压缩、推理解释为随机性恢复，并把高效模型的最优损失联系到next-bit pseudoentropy；与ML计算复杂度和压缩理论直接相关，但没有可操作的架构/系统方法，故P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Optimal and Efficient Contextual Combinatorial Semi-bandits with General Function Approximation
historical_p2.why: SquareCB.Comb给出一般函数逼近下的最优遗憾界，并将计算可行性建立在在线回归Oracle和高效线性优化/采样条件上，属于算法层面的效率与样本决策效率；但没有训练/推理成本、硬件或系统级测量，故仅作P2理论邻域记录。

historical_p2.title: Conservative neural posterior estimation via distributionally robust training
historical_p2.why: DRO-NPE强调有限模拟预算下的可校准神经后验估计，并兼容normalizing flow且可并行执行，和生成式统计模型的训练预算管理有关；但没有训练时延、显存或部署成本对比，故P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty
historical_p2.why: 该工作面向偏好不确定性的LLM对齐，提出单循环primal-dual proxy game并给出收敛界，属于LLM训练/对齐优化算法邻域；但没有训练token、GPU小时、收敛墙钟时间或推理成本对比，故P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Agentic AI in medicine: architectures, applications, evaluation, and challenges for clinical translation
historical_p2.why: This is a broad survey of medical agent architectures and evaluation, including tool use, memory, and multi-agent workflows. It is relevant background for agent systems but does not propose or measure efficient inference, runtime, memory, or compute mechanisms.

historical_p2.title: Behavioral Residualization for Unsupervised Intrusion Detection in Automotive CAN Networks
historical_p2.why: The paper applies standard unsupervised ML detectors to automotive CAN intrusion detection and includes deployment-oriented latency evaluation. It is an embedded-ML application rather than a new model-serving or hardware-efficiency method; retain as a low-priority edge-ML reference.

historical_p2.title: SAGE: Stochastic Prompt Optimization via Agent-Guided Exploration
historical_p2.why: SAGE studies stochastic and agent-guided prompt optimization with diagnostic code execution and repeated A/B testing. It is relevant to efficient agent workflows in a broad sense, but the abstract does not establish lower model-compute cost, token use, latency, or infrastructure efficiency.

historical_p2.title: From Solvers to Research: Large Language Model-Driven Formal Mathematics at the Research Frontier
historical_p2.why: This survey covers LLM formal mathematics, including inference-time search, adaptation, and agentic workflows. It is relevant to reasoning-system context but does not introduce or quantify a compute-, memory-, or latency-efficient inference mechanism.

historical_p2.title: Riemannian Lyapunov Framework: Optimization as Closed Loop Control on Riemannian Manifolds
historical_p2.why: The Riemannian Lyapunov framework unifies optimizer dynamics and includes image-classification and language-modeling experiments. It is adjacent to training-optimizer research, but the abstract gives no convergence-time, training-throughput, memory, or energy advantage.

historical_p2.title: Free energy landscape of Dense Associative Memory
historical_p2.why: The paper derives free-energy results for dense associative memories and analyzes memory retrieval. It is adjacent to alternative neural-memory architectures, but it provides no implementation, scaling, or efficiency evidence.

historical_p2.title: Place-it-R1: Unlocking Environment-aware Reasoning Potential of MLLM for Video Object Insertion
historical_p2.why: Place-it-R1 combines MLLM environment reasoning with video diffusion guidance and preference optimization for physically plausible object insertion. It is directly adjacent to multimodal/video generation, but the abstract reports quality rather than acceleration or resource savings.

historical_p2.title: Adversarial Robustness of Activation Steering in Large Language Models
historical_p2.why: 研究LLM推理时activation steering在对抗输入下的鲁棒性，直接涉及模型推理路径，但目标是控制可靠性而非减少计算、KV、内存或时延，保留为低优先级LLM inference邻域。

historical_p2.title: Sanyu Studio: A Multi-Agent System for Art-Historical Narrative Construction
historical_p2.why: Sanyu Studio将多智能体LLM用于艺术史叙事与用户交互，涉及agent组织和记忆过滤，但摘要没有推理吞吐、token、内存、时延或成本优化，作为低优先级agent系统应用记录。

historical_p2.title: Activation-Based Active Learning for In-Context Learning: Challenges and Insights
historical_p2.why: 论文评估Transformer激活能否用于LLM in-context example selection，并报告负结果；与LLM上下文构造和推理前处理相邻，但没有证明token、计算或时延节省，保留为低优先级方法学证据。

historical_p2.title: Beyond Single-shot Writing: Deep Research Agents are Unreliable at Multi-turn Report Revision
historical_p2.why: Mr Dre评估Deep Research Agent多轮报告修订中的内容回退与引用质量，涉及agent多轮执行可靠性；没有降低推理成本、token消耗或系统时延的机制。

historical_p2.title: NIV: Neural Axis Variations for Variable Font Generation
historical_p2.why: NIV用神经网络从静态字体生成可变字体，属于结构化几何生成模型；摘要未报告参数压缩、采样加速、内存或部署效率收益，作为低优先级生成模型邻域记录。

historical_p2.title: A Layered Simplex Architecture for Large Alphabets
historical_p2.why: Layered Simplex研究大字母表预测中的架构先验与贝叶斯预测表达，属于模型架构与统计学习理论邻域；摘要未证明训练/推理计算成本下降或系统级效率收益。

historical_p2.title: Sustainable operation of research infrastructure for novel computing
historical_p2.why: 论文介绍BrainScaleS-2神经形态平台及其与传统集群耦合的研究基础设施运维，涉及异构计算平台和资源隔离；但不是ML工作负载的加速或效率实证，低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: Hyper-Dimensional Fingerprints as Molecular Representations
historical_p2.why: HDF以确定性、免训练的超维指纹替代部分计算密集型分子GNN表征，并在64维表示上保持有竞争力的相似性与样本效率；但证据集中在分子性质预测，尚无通用模型推理成本或硬件效率结果，低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: Classical State Preparation for Variational Quantum Algorithms via Reinforcement Learning
historical_p2.why: CRiSP用Transformer策略和MCTS为变分量子算法选择Clifford前缀，以warm-start改善优化结果并避免部分启发式搜索瓶颈；属于量子机器学习的训练初始化效率邻域，但未报告通用ML训练时间或资源节省，低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: Cova-PINN: Cross-Domain Conservation Physics-Informed Neural Network for Fluid-Solid Conjugate Heat Transfer in Complex Geometries
historical_p2.why: Cova-PINN通过跨域守恒支持对齐改进复杂几何流固换热的物理信息网络，具有科学ML训练/建模方法的邻接价值；但摘要没有训练FLOPs、收敛成本或推理加速数据，故仅P2。

historical_p2.title: Large-Language-Model Discovery of Quantum LDPC Codes through Structured Concept Evolution
historical_p2.why: 该工作让LLM在固定搜索步数预算内演化量子LDPC码构造程序，体现了LLM驱动的程序搜索与搜索策略优化，和agentic reasoning/搜索效率有邻接关系；但目标是专用量子纠错码设计，不是模型本身的训练、推理或serving效率，因此仅低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route
historical_p2.why: 摘要明确报告以小型量子神经模块替换注意力路由模型中的前馈模块，可减少56.6%参数且在小中规模实例上接近经典基线，属于明确的参数效率证据；但应用局限于车辆路径规划，规模扩大后性能差距上升，且未给出推理时延、能耗或实际部署收益，故仅作低优先级记录。

historical_p2.title: The surprising simplicity of forecasting quantum chaotic many-body dynamics
historical_p2.why: 论文发现DLinear在量子多体动力学预测任务上可用简单线性映射达到较强效果，而Transformer在部分状态区间退化，提供了以简单模型替代复杂模型的潜在效率线索；但摘要未量化参数、时延、能耗或吞吐收益，仅低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: Trainable Quantum-Native Language Models: Dissipative Memory, Capacity Limits, and Hardware Validation
historical_p2.why: 论文研究小量子寄存器上的自回归语言模型、耗散记忆和KV式记忆容量边界，直接触及语言模型状态与上下文存储机制；但作者明确指出模型可被经典模拟且显著弱于经典n-gram基线，没有量子计算优势，因此只作低优先级架构观察。

historical_p2.title: Action-Conditioned World Model for Goal Plane Guidance in Robotic Neck Ultrasound
historical_p2.why: 该工作将条件扩散世界模型与目标条件Transformer用于机器人超声探头导航，并报告真实闭环成功率，属于物理世界中的动作生成/机器人策略方向；但摘要未量化模型推理时延、算力、能耗或缓存效率，故作为Physical-AI邻域P2保留，不晋级。

historical_p2.title: Ask the World Before Acting: Environment Probing for Calibrating Agent World Models
historical_p2.why: ENVPROBE通过主动查询环境纠正长时程语言Agent的过期信念，和Agent运行时状态维护相关；摘要只报告状态准确性与可靠性提升，没有探测开销、token成本、时延或吞吐收益，保留为低优先级Agent系统邻域。

historical_p2.title: ThermoAct:Thermal-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Perception and Decision-Making
historical_p2.why: ThermoAct是融合热成像的视觉-语言-动作框架，使用VLM规划并执行机器人子任务，属于受保护的VLA/Physical-AI方向；但摘要没有量化推理效率或硬件部署成本，故仅作P2跟踪。

historical_p2.title: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
historical_p2.why: Slot-JEPA将稠密视觉表示拆成稳定语义槽和空间掩码，并用紧凑掩码记忆支持世界模型规划，实验覆盖机器人手臂规划；其结构化状态接口与Physical-AI视觉记忆相关，但未给出推理时延、内存节省或能耗量化，列P2。

historical_p2.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
historical_p2.why: OmniVerifier-C1研究多模态生成验证器及其RL训练，覆盖文本到图像和规则约束世界模拟；贡献是验证质量与泛化，而非生成吞吐、采样步数、显存或推理加速，作为生成式模型评估邻域P2保留。

historical_p2.title: EndoWorld-JEPA: Motion-Guided Global-Local Latent World Modeling for Endoscopic Video Representation Learning
historical_p2.why: EndoWorld-JEPA利用光流运动线索学习内窥镜视频的全局-局部潜在动态表示，属于物理场景视频表征方向；摘要没有视频编码/推理成本、token压缩或运行时加速指标，因此仅保留低优先级。

historical_p2.title: LithoWorld: An Endpoint World Model for Lithography Process-Window Recovery
historical_p2.why: LithoWorld使用端点世界模型和条件Flow策略生成光刻工艺参数修正，具有物理过程动作生成的邻接性；实验报告工艺恢复成功率，但没有模型推理成本或流生成加速证据，故作为低优先级Flow/物理过程方向保留。

historical_p2.title: RadioDreamer: A World Model for Radio Map Forecasting and Imagination-Based Optimization
historical_p2.why: RadioDreamer将动作条件无线电地图预测与想象式网络配置优化结合，报告预测误差和累计回报提升；但没有网络推理服务、模型成本或加速器效率数据，作为网络智能控制邻域P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Shape Distribution Matters: Shape-Specific Mixture-of-Experts for Amodal Segmentation Under Diverse Occlusions
historical_p2.why: ShapeMoE采用形状分布驱动的稀疏专家路由和轻量专家用于遮挡分割，和稀疏MoE视觉模型相关；摘要没有激活专家数量、FLOPs、时延或能耗对比，效率证据不足，仅列P2。

historical_p2.title: An LLM-powered Agentic Recommendation System for Connected TV Content Discovery
historical_p2.why: 该工作描述生产级CTV推荐系统，以LLM处理异构上下文并由传统模型承担高效检索与排序，重点讨论推理时延和混合架构取舍；缺少可复现的硬件/吞吐量化，作为生产Agent/推荐系统邻域P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Paved with True Intents: Intent-Aware Training Improves LLM Safety Classification Across Training Regimes
historical_p2.why: AIMS研究意图感知安全分类训练，并报告模型在推理时延-F1 Pareto前沿上的表现；与轻量化LLM安全判别有一定相关性，但摘要没有明确模型规模、延迟数值或部署成本，暂列P2。

historical_p2.title: MarkTune: Improving the Quality-Detectability Trade-off in Model-Embedded LLM Watermarking
historical_p2.why: MarkTune通过权重内嵌水印避免推理时修改采样流程，讨论质量与可检测性权衡；其免除额外推理开销具有邻接价值，但主要贡献是水印训练方法而非通用推理加速，列P2。

historical_p2.title: From Clicks to Intent: Cross-Platform Session Embeddings with LLM-Distilled Taxonomy for Financial Services Recommendations
historical_p2.why: 该工作在金融服务推荐中联合使用紧凑会话嵌入与LLM蒸馏意图标签，并给出生产任务Recall、Log Loss和低延迟标签推理结果；但没有端到端服务成本、吞吐或硬件数据，保留为P2。

historical_p2.title: LLM-Guided Evolution of Symbolic Acceleration Inequality Families for MILP
historical_p2.why: SAGE使用LLM Agent演化MILP加速不等式，并报告求解目标差距和达到目标差距的时间收益；其加速对象是数学规划求解器而非ML训练/推理系统，作为高效推理/Agent辅助优化的邻接P2记录。

historical_p2.title: A primer on evaluation methods for large language models in healthcare
historical_p2.why: 该综述覆盖医疗LLM评估，并将token使用量和时延列为运行指标，但没有提出效率优化方法或新的系统机制；作为评估规范参考低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: SpineContextResUNet: A Computationally Efficient Residual UNet for Spine CT Segmentation
historical_p2.why: SpineContextResUNet以约1.7M参数和轻量上下文模块面向Jetson Orin Nano等资源受限设备，提供了小模型边缘推理的部署参考；但摘要缺少实际时延、功耗和内存占用的量化对比，暂列P2而非高价值晋级。

historical_p2.title: Energy Estimation for Virtual Servers Using Resource Utilization and Machine Learning
historical_p2.why: 该工作使用ML估计虚拟服务器功耗，并称部署推理直接CPU功耗开销较低，和能效监测基础设施相关；但不优化模型本身的训练/推理效率，缺少量化推理开销，故仅作P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Distributionally Robust Regularization of Sparse Integer Programming Trained Learning Models
historical_p2.why: 以分布鲁棒正则化规避稀疏整数模型训练中计算昂贵的交叉验证，并给出统计保证；属于训练/模型选择成本优化，但应用范围较窄且无系统级实测，列为低优先级。

historical_p2.why: StepTrigger exposes a contact-state-triggered backdoor surface in a VLM-powered quadruped planner. It is adjacent to the protected Physical-AI/VLA neighborhood and useful for system-risk context, but it does not improve serving or inference efficiency.

historical_p2.why: Directly related to real-robot bimanual manipulation and uses a diffusion model, but the contribution is grasp generation and execution refinement rather than efficient inference, serving, or resource management. Retain as low-priority Physical-AI adjacent work.

historical_p2.title: LUTstructions: Fast-Reconfigurable FPGA-Based Instructions

historical_p2.why: The clustering-and-conquer method improves sample complexity for large-scale ranking and selection and is demonstrated in neural architecture search, so it is relevant to sample-efficient AutoML; it does not optimize model training or inference serving.

historical_p2.why: The fractional heat-kernel pipeline reaches strong graph-learning accuracy with one label per class, providing a sample-efficient semi-supervised learning result; the abstract does not show reduced compute, memory, or inference latency.

historical_p2.why: WoundAmbit benchmarks segmentation models for telehealth and reports CPU inference of at least one image per second, giving low-priority deployment-efficiency evidence; it does not introduce a new model optimization or systems technique.

historical_p2.why: The elicitability-based deep-learning method avoids computationally expensive nested Monte Carlo simulations for FBSDEs, making it relevant to scientific-ML training efficiency; retain at low priority because the abstract provides no matched resource benchmark.

historical_p2.why: The lambda-hold controller reduces policy query frequency and enables rapid RL training for human-like musculoskeletal movement, so it is retained in the protected Physical-AI action-generation neighborhood; it is a specialized predictive simulation result rather than VLA serving acceleration.

historical_p2.title: Control Variate Design for Score-Function Gradient Estimators in Importance-Weighted Variational Inference

historical_p2.title: Optimal hypersurface decision trees

historical_p2.title: Interacting Annealed Importance Sampling via Population-Based MCMC Kernels
historical_p2.why: Interacting annealed importance sampling uses population-based MCMC interactions to improve exploration and sampling efficiency. It is a genuine computational-statistics efficiency method, but it is not a neural-network serving or accelerator contribution and the abstract lacks matched resource metrics. Retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: An integrated interpretable control effectiveness learning and nonlinear control allocation methodology for overactuated aircraft
historical_p2.why: The aircraft-control method learns a compact, interpretable physics-constrained control-effectiveness model using sparse system identification, then uses analytical derivatives and online adaptation for real-time nonlinear control allocation. The abstract explicitly reports substantially lower computational cost than a full nonlinear onboard model while maintaining comparable accuracy. Retain as a low-priority physical-control/embedded-compute result; it is not VLA/WAM inference or robot-policy serving, so it does not enter the protected VLA-serving tier.

historical_p2.title: Enhancing Offline Model-Based RL via Active Model Selection: A Bayesian Optimization Perspective
historical_p2.why: BOMS uses Bayesian optimization and a computationally efficient model-induced kernel to select dynamics models for offline model-based RL, with online interaction limited to roughly 1%-2.5% of offline training data. This is sample-efficient model selection for RL, but not a direct reduction in policy inference or serving cost. Retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: Microstructure-Conditioned Surrogate Models for Graded Multiscale Optimization of Mycelium Composites
historical_p2.why: The paper uses a microstructure-conditioned neural surrogate to make multiscale finite-element simulations tractable with fewer training samples. This is scientific-ML surrogate acceleration rather than ML-system acceleration; retain as a low-priority cross-domain example because it directly replaces expensive simulation with learned prediction.

historical_p2.title: Data-Efficient Indentation Size Effect Mitigation in Steels Using Machine Learning and a Physics-Constrained Neural Network
historical_p2.why: The physics-constrained neural-network workflow predicts material hardness from shallow indentation using only a small reference dataset and demonstrates transfer across steels. This is data-efficient scientific ML, but it does not show lower training compute, inference cost, or deployment resources. Retain only as low-priority sample-efficiency context.

historical_p2.title: MASC: Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction via Reinforcement Learning for Accelerated MRI
historical_p2.why: MASC uses an RL policy to select undersampled MRI k-space lines jointly with artifact correction, optimizing acquisition under a limited sampling budget. The acceleration is primarily MRI acquisition and reconstruction quality, not neural inference acceleration; retain as low-priority RL-based acquisition optimization.

historical_p2.title: SpectralTrain: A Universal Framework for Hyperspectral Image Classification
historical_p2.why: SpectralTrain combines curriculum learning with PCA-based hyperspectral downsampling and reports 2-7x reductions in training time with small-to-moderate accuracy deltas. This is a concrete training-efficiency result, but it is specialized to hyperspectral classification and does not target general model serving. Retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: MBTI: A Multi-Branch Efficient Fine-Tuning Framework for Hyperspectral Image Classification with Foundation Models
historical_p2.why: MBTI adapts hyperspectral foundation models with multi-branch preprocessing and LoRA, leaving only about 2.33%-2.36% of parameters trainable. This is parameter-efficient fine-tuning, but the abstract does not quantify training-time, memory, or end-to-end adaptation savings. Retain as a low-priority PEFT result.

historical_p2.title: Learning to Interfere in Non-Orthogonal Multiple-Access Joint Source-Channel Coding
historical_p2.why: The ML-aided wireless image-transmission method jointly uses compression and channel coding, supports up to 64 simultaneous users, and increases trainable parameters by only 2.4% over a single-user model. This is relevant to edge/cloud communication and heterogeneous ML systems, but the abstract does not quantify bandwidth, energy, latency, or end-to-end compute savings. Retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: OSCAR: Obstacle Survival Curves for Adaptive Robot Navigation
historical_p2.why: OSCAR learns obstacle-class survival distributions and uses them to choose wait-versus-reroute thresholds for a mobile robot, with real-robot evaluation and online adaptation. This is adjacent to Physical-AI runtime and navigation policy systems, but the abstract does not show lower policy-inference compute, latency, memory, or energy. Retain as low-priority physical-world runtime coverage.

historical_p2.title: Show Me What You Don't Know: Efficient Sampling from Invariant Sets for Model Validation
historical_p2.why: The invariance-auditing method reuses a pretrained diffusion or flow-matching model to sample feature-invariant inputs, avoiding the need to train a separate generative model for each feature extractor; the abstract says this replaces days of training with one guided-generation procedure at comparable quality. This is a training-workflow saving for model validation rather than a diffusion-serving acceleration, so retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: To Distill or Decide? Understanding the Algorithmic Trade-off in Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning
historical_p2.why: The paper studies privileged expert distillation for partially observable RL and states that it is more computationally efficient than RL without latent-state information, with controlled locomotion experiments. This is relevant to policy-learning efficiency in embodied systems, but the abstract provides no matched compute or runtime figures and does not address VLA serving. Retain as low-priority Physical-AI training context.

historical_p2.title: Orlicz-Sobolev with Musielak: An Efficient Regularization Approach for Graph-based IPM
historical_p2.why: The generalized Sobolev IPM uses an Orlicz-Sobolev/Musielak regularization and graph structure to reduce a difficult optimization to a univariate problem. The abstract reports computation several orders faster than the popular Orlicz-Wasserstein baseline, with applications to document classification and topological data analysis. This is a real algorithmic-compute improvement, but it is a specialized distribution-comparison method rather than ML systems or serving. Retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: Actionable CBFI: Prescriptive Interventional Diagnosis and Interaction-Aware Escalation for Sparse Causal Algorithmic Recourse
historical_p2.why: Actionable CBFI prescribes single actions before searching joint interventions and reports fewer direct actions and fewer model evaluations than untargeted causal beam search (119 versus 150 evaluations). This is a measurable reduction in inference-time model queries for algorithmic recourse, but the task is specialized tabular decision support rather than general serving. Retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: Towards AI-Assisted Clinical Trial Matching: Practical Considerations, Multicenter Evaluation, and Real-World Deployment
historical_p2.why: TrialGPT 2.0 is a real-world clinical-trial matching system with multicenter evaluation and reports a 55% reduction in clinician screening time while improving trial retrieval. This is meaningful deployment-workflow efficiency for an AI-assisted recommendation system, but it does not establish lower model inference cost, latency, memory, or token usage. Retain only as a low-priority human-in-the-loop deployment reference.

historical_p2.title: Towards Reasonable Concept Bottleneck Models
historical_p2.why: CREAM extends concept-bottleneck models with structured concept relationships and sparse concept-to-task links, supports interventions without additional computational overhead, and retains performance under missing concepts. This is relevant to efficient, interpretable model intervention, but the abstract does not demonstrate a net compute or latency reduction. Retain at low priority.

historical_p2.title: Flexible Inverse Design of Optical Multilayer Coatings Using Discrete-Continuous Flow Matching
historical_p2.why: IrisFlow uses discrete-continuous flow matching for inverse design of optical multilayer coatings and, with local refinement, reduces transfer-matrix evaluations by about 500-fold versus needle optimization at comparable accuracy. This is a substantial search-compute reduction in a specialized scientific inverse-design workload, but not a general flow-model inference accelerator. Retain as low-priority generative inverse-design efficiency.

historical_p2.title: Non-linear mechanical field reconstruction coupling recurrent neural networks with physics-informed graph neural networks
historical_p2.why: LSTM-GNN代理模型将非线性微结构有限元场重建加速约三个数量级，存在明确计算效率证据；但任务高度专用，未涉及通用ML系统或部署硬件，因此仅作科学ML低优先级记录。

historical_p2.title: Is Flow Matching Just Trajectory Replay for Sequential Data?
historical_p2.why: 从序列数据flow-matching目标推导闭式速度场并提出training-free FreeFM，具有减少训练/采样负担的邻接价值；但应用是专用时间序列预测，缺少通用生成模型或serving测量。

historical_p2.title: Imagine Before You Draw: Visual Prompt Engineering for Image Generation
historical_p2.why: 提出用于图像生成的视觉语义提示机制并报告收敛加速与编辑响应性，属于图像生成架构优化邻域；摘要没有给出推理吞吐、时延或能耗收益，暂列P2。

historical_p2.title: Latent Evolution Operator (LEO): State-to-State Forecasting of Parametric PDEs
historical_p2.why: LEO以单次潜空间状态映射替代逐步递归积分，并报告相对Autoencoder-LSTM的显著加速；属于科学ML降阶代理模型，保留为低优先级效率证据。

historical_p2.title: Vorch-Human: Unified Multi-Task Human-Centric Generation via Long-Horizon Continuation
historical_p2.why: 统一音视频扩散Transformer并采用冻结前缀、仅生成新后缀的长视频递归机制，和长时视频生成的计算复用有关；摘要未给出时延/吞吐对比，暂列P2。

historical_p2.title: A Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning Method for Heterogeneous Clients
historical_p2.why: 联邦学习客户端按算力选择HE或DP，摘要报告相对HE-only显著降低计算时间，直接涉及异构客户端的分布式ML计算效率；但场景受隐私与组学应用限制，列为P2。

historical_p2.title: Machine Learning for Coding Retail Product Names to Consumer-Price Categories: A Rule-plus-Bag-of-Words Pipeline with Reliability-Weighted Human-in-the-Loop Labeling
historical_p2.why: 在零售文本分类中量化不同模型的训练和CPU推理成本，显示简单字符n-gram模型可显著降低成本且保持准确率；任务较窄，但提供直接的模型选择与计算成本证据。

historical_p2.title: Smooth Flow Matching for Synthesizing Functional Data
historical_p2.why: 提出面向函数型数据的Smooth Flow Matching，并明确报告计算效率优势，属于flow生成方法的效率邻域；应用偏临床轨迹数据，缺少通用扩散/flow serving测量。

historical_p2.title: Entropic perspective on AI resilience, data-minimal learning and optimal control
historical_p2.why: 摘要主张以少量训练数据和更简单、低描述长度模型获得较强性能，和数据效率/模型复杂度优化相关；但论证范围宽泛且缺少清晰系统测量，需全文核验后再决定是否升级。

historical_p2.title: Dynamic Cross-Modal Prompt Generation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
historical_p2.why: DRAPE面向多模态持续指令调优，通过实例级软提示和原型路由替代固定prompt/LoRA模块组合，属于MLLM参数高效适配邻域；摘要未证明推理成本或内存收益。

historical_p2.title: An Optimal Control Approach To Transformer Training
historical_p2.why: 提出对Transformer训练控制问题的状态、概率测度和动作三重量化，属于量化训练方法的理论邻域；摘要没有实证吞吐、显存或能耗收益，保留P2待全文核验。

historical_p2.title: An Attribute-Based Measure of Video Complexity
historical_p2.why: VideoABC以低维属性与量化单元估计视频问题复杂度，并以较低复杂度优于Video-LLM-as-judge，和多模态评测成本控制有关；但不是serving优化，列P2。

historical_p2.title: Beyond Prompt and Parser Engineering: Soft-Prompt Tuning for Automated LLM Evaluation
historical_p2.why: 通过仅优化10个软提示向量、约0.0006%参数并在约150步内完成格式适配，降低LLM评测适配成本；应用限于评测格式校准，不代表通用推理加速，列P2。

historical_p2.title: Manifold Sampling via Entropy Maximization
historical_p2.why: MASEM针对未知多连通约束流形提出熵最大化重采样，并在合成与机器人基准上报告更快、可扩展的混合表现；属于采样算法效率邻域，但不是模型训练/推理系统优化，列P2。

historical_p2.title: SkillFlow: Flow-Driven Recursive Skill Evolution for Agentic Orchestration
historical_p2.why: SkillFlow将flow-matching训练信号用于Agent技能演化，并称反向策略带来零额外推理成本；与Agent编排和推理开销有关，但摘要未提供端到端时延/成本对比，列P2。

historical_p2.title: Linear-Core Surrogates: Smooth Loss Functions with Linear Rates for Classification and Structured Prediction
historical_p2.why: Linear-Core Surrogates通过平滑损失与线性一致性保证，令结构化预测随机梯度估计绕过每步O(|Y|^2)精确推理，并报告相对Structured SVM 23倍加速；算法层效率明确，但领域较窄，列P2。

historical_p2.title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
historical_p2.why: Ego-OSCAR提供低成本开源头戴式立体视觉/IMU采集、嵌入式编码与时钟同步平台，并发布大规模第一视角数据；属于Physical AI感知数据基础设施而非ML加速器，作为保护性P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Beyond Prediction-Set Size: Quantifying Conformal Uncertainty through Credal Geometry
historical_p2.why: 对共形不确定性指标给出精确算法，将潜在指数级计算降为排序后的线性时间；属于ML评估/不确定性计算的明确复杂度优化，但不是核心serving方向，列P2。

historical_p2.title: Learning to Emulate Chaos: Adversarial Optimal Transport Regularization
historical_p2.why: 研究对抗最优传输正则化的混沌动力学ML模拟器，明确以加速仿真为应用动机并改善长期统计保真度；摘要未给出实际加速倍数，保留科学ML低优先级记录。

historical_p2.title: Risk-Conditioned Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
historical_p2.why: 风险条件化RLHF用单一策略在推理时连续调节风险偏好，避免为不同风险等级训练/部署多个策略模型；具有模型整合与部署成本价值，但没有直接吞吐/时延测量。

historical_p2.title: Multidimensional Bayesian Active Machine Learning of Working Memory Task Performance
historical_p2.why: 贝叶斯主动分类通过不确定性驱动采样，约30个样本即可拟合完整双轴模型，具有明确样本效率价值；应用为工作记忆实验，列P2。

historical_p2.title: Development of a Low-Cost Prosthetic Hand Using Electromyography and Machine Learning
historical_p2.why: 低成本肌电假肢手采用浅层神经网络进行手势分类，并比较时域特征的更快计算/响应；属于嵌入式Physical AI感知与执行链路，虽缺少量化加速数据，按保护性P2保留。

historical_p2.title: Exploring the Underwater World Segmentation without Extra Training
historical_p2.why: Earth2Ocean以training-free方式将既有VLM迁移到水下开放词汇分割，并报告高效推理；与减少特定视觉任务的训练成本和推理开销相关，但主贡献仍是数据集与任务框架，非通用系统加速。

historical_p2.title: AEIOU: A Unified Defense Framework against NSFW Prompts in Text-to-Image Models
historical_p2.why: AEIOU利用文本编码器隐藏状态进行T2I安全检测，摘要报告最小推理时间并称效率较现有工具至少提高10倍；但它是特定安全过滤器，非核心生成模型或通用服务加速。

historical_p2.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data via APIs 3: Using Simulators Instead of Foundation Model
historical_p2.why: Sim-PE将图形生成器和物理模拟器纳入差分隐私合成数据流程，摘要报告分类准确率最高提升3倍、FID最高降低80%且效率更高；与减少基础模型API依赖的计算成本相关，但主线是DP合成数据。

historical_p2.title: PVD-ONet: A Multi-scale Neural Operator Method for Singularly Perturbed Boundary Layer Problems
historical_p2.why: PVD-ONet面向奇异摄动边界层问题，摘要强调神经算子可对问题族进行无需重训练的高效预测；属于科学ML模型效率的专用案例，但未给出系统级时延或能耗基准。

historical_p2.title: Bouncy particle sampler with infinite exchanging parallel tempering
historical_p2.why: BPS-PT通过无限交换并行退火改善多峰分布采样，摘要报告更高的ESS/计算时间；属于贝叶斯采样算法效率，而非深度学习系统优化。

historical_p2.title: Learning to Test: Latent Representation Learning for Dynamic Instability Detection
historical_p2.why: Learning to Test用潜在表示检测DAE系统动态不稳定性，目标是避免反复大规模仿真并支持高维或实时场景；与学习型替代计算相关，但摘要主要贡献是统计安全检验有效性。

historical_p2.title: Sampling from multimodal distributions with warm starts: Non-asymptotic bounds for the Reweighted Annealed Leap-Point Sampler
historical_p2.why: Reweighted ALPS为多峰分布采样给出多项式时间界，并通过warm-start与teleportation改善混合；属于采样计算效率，非深度模型服务加速。

historical_p2.title: All-Electric Heavy-Duty Robotic Manipulator: Surrogate-Enhanced Modeling and Adaptive Modular Control
historical_p2.why: 重载机械臂控制框架将神经网络执行器代理模型嵌入模块化控制，并报告实时控制与亚厘米跟踪；属于Physical-AI中的ML surrogate deployment案例，但摘要没有独立推理延迟或能耗基准，列P2并保留Physical-AI标记。

historical_p2.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
historical_p2.why: 提出置信度感知的on-policy distillation与自适应监督，属于训练阶段的teacher-student知识迁移方法；摘要主要报告任务精度收益，未量化训练算力、模型规模或推理成本，因此仅作低优先级方法学保留。

historical_p2.title: LOOP-MAC: Learning-Based Multi-Agent Coordination with Guaranteed Local Feasibility in a Virtual Power Plant
historical_p2.why: 通过学习式协调减少虚拟电厂多智能体的通信轮次，并报告100-agent场景下约1.1 ms的单智能体在线计算；有明确计算/通信效率信号，但应用域是能源调度而非通用ML系统，保留为低优先级算法效率候选。

historical_p2.title: Generalized Multi-agent Social Simulation Framework
historical_p2.why: 框架包含面向LLM多智能体社会模拟的记忆摘要与上下文筛选机制，和agent上下文管理相关；但摘要没有token、延迟、显存或成本对比，且主要贡献是仿真框架，故仅保留为低优先级线索。

historical_p2.title: Constitutive parameterized deep energy method for solid mechanics problems with random material parameters
historical_p2.why: 物理驱动的参数化深度能量方法试图在材料参数变化时避免重复数据生成和模型重训练，并支持zero-shot实时位移场推理；具有科学机器学习推理复用价值，但摘要未给出可核验的成本/速度对比，暂列P2。

historical_p2.title: Physics-Integrated Operator Learning via Gaussian Splatting Representations
historical_p2.why: 将Gaussian-splatting连续场表示引入神经算子，利用闭式导数融合已知PDE结构并改善长时域预测误差；属于高效科学ML表示/算子方向，但摘要未报告计算成本或吞吐收益，低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: A Distribution-to-Distribution Neural Probabilistic Forecasting Framework for Dynamical Systems
historical_p2.why: 以分布编码/解码和递归神经预测替代显式ensemble轨迹模拟，存在减少传统分布演化与采样开销的潜在效率意义；但目前仅Lorenz63概念验证，未给出成本量化，列为P2。

historical_p2.title: BeatEdit: Symbolic Music Generation as Explicit Editing
historical_p2.why: BeatEdit将符号音乐生成转化为显式编辑，并报告单次推理低于100 ms，存在具体推理时延证据；但领域较窄且不属于当前核心系统方向，保留为P2。

historical_p2.title: Event-Grounded Sparse Autoencoders for Vision-Language-Action Policies
historical_p2.topic: VLA稀疏表征 / 行为可解释性
historical_p2.why: 论文将稀疏自编码器用于VLA行为事件解释，含闭环仿真和真实机器人验证，但核心贡献是可解释性与干预分析，并未减少模型权重、激活或token，也没有报告推理吞吐/时延收益；作为Physical AI相关低优先级观察。

historical_p2.title: World Models as Adversaries: Multi-Agent Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Robust Motion Planning
historical_p2.topic: Physical AI / 自动驾驶鲁棒规划
historical_p2.why: 工作以多智能体自博弈增强自动驾驶规划器对长尾场景的鲁棒性，涉及world model和闭环评估；摘要没有展示推理成本、时延、内存或部署加速，属于Physical AI算法研究而非高效推理，低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: FedDyMem: Efficient Federated Learning with Dynamic Memory and Memory-Reduce for Unsupervised Image Anomaly Detection
historical_p2.topic: 联邦学习 / 动态记忆通信压缩
historical_p2.why: FedDyMem通过动态记忆库与压缩交换降低联邦异常检测的通信负担，确有分布式训练效率属性；但场景较窄且重点是无监督工业/医疗图像异常检测，尚不足以进入核心高价值队列，保留P2供后续检索。

historical_p2.title: CubeDAgger: Interactive Imitation Learning for Dynamic Systems with Efficient yet Low-risk Interaction
historical_p2.topic: Physical AI / 动态机器人模仿学习
historical_p2.why: CubeDAgger研究动态系统中的交互式模仿学习与动作稳定性，包含真实机器人实验，但重点是训练交互策略而非动作生成推理效率、缓存或硬件部署；与Physical AI方向有关，暂作低优先级保留。

historical_p2.title: Tiny but Trusted: Efficient Vision-Language Reasoning for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
historical_p2.topic: 多模态模型 / 参数高效VLM应用
historical_p2.why: Tiny but Trusted构建时间序列异常检测的轻量VLM和参数高效微调方案，属于多模态应用模型；摘要未提供模型大小、推理延迟、吞吐、内存或端侧部署数据，效率证据不足，保留P2而不升级。

historical_p2.title: Autoregressive Diffusion World Models for Off-Policy Evaluation of LLM Agents
historical_p2.topic: Agent系统 / 扩散世界模型离线评测
